name: Encoder Architecture for Variational Gaussians
definition: An encoder that obtains variational 3D Gaussian representation from two given reference views. It consists of a vision transformer, an epipolar transformer, and a per-pixel sampling head. It predicts means $\mathbf {h}_\mu$ and variances $\mathbf {h}_\sigma$ of spherical harmonic coefficients for view-dependent features.
summary: This encoder transforms two reference views into variational 3D Gaussians by predicting distributions for both geometry and appearance, distinguishing itself through explicit uncertainty modeling.
